# Photomicrograph_Graph_Extraction

**Domain**: Cross
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
The process of converting microscopy images of nanowire networks into graph-theoretic models via image processing and segmentation. Enables quantitative analysis and design of physical neural networks from real fabricated samples, bridging experimental and theoretical TCC/iNEST research.
